Confirmed from the gazette: section 3 of the 2026 Act amends section 1(4) of the 2006 Act (application/exclusions: seafarers, small agricultural farms, domestic workers) and section 4 amends section 2 (definitions, adding agricultural worker, agricultural farm, domestic worker).
gold_answer_gist: The Bangladesh Labour (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. 43 of 2026, in force 10 April 2026; amendment_overlay, in_force=true, legal_status=ratified) changes provisions that also exist in the consolidated base, which stops at the 2018 amendments. The answer must surface BOTH with labels — the overlay as [current text — enacted amendment] and the base as [earlier text — amended by a later Act] — and must NOT state the pre-2026 base text as the current law, nor describe the amendment as pending or as the 2025 Ordinance.
notes: Dual-layer conflict query, rewritten 2026-11-12. The earlier version targeted a '2025 Ordinance' overlay that was never in the corpus: bangladeshgagette2025 is a one-page increment notice, and the chunk-id pairs recorded here before (sections 1-4) were artefacts of that misidentification. The 2025 Ordinance has since been replaced by the 2026 Act. Two blockers before this query can pass: (1) the 2026 Act PDF has no usable text layer and must be OCR'd or transcribed and re-ingested; (2) Stage 7 pairs base and overlay by section_number, but an amending Act's own section numbers differ from the sections it amends (its section 3 amends section 1 of the 2006 Act), so the overlay chunks need an 'amends_section' field for pairing to be correct.
